statement: Smirnov's square-lattice FK parafermionic spin is sigma(q)=1-(2/pi) arccos(sqrt(q)/2); therefore sigma(1)=1/3 for independent bond percolation, whereas sigma(2)=1/2 for FK-Ising. The local intake attempt C0017-A001's sigma=2/3 is incorrect under this convention.
assumptions: Smirnov's winding-weight convention F(z)=E[1_{z in gamma} exp(-i sigma winding)] and q in [0,4]
proof_or_counterexample: At q=1, sqrt(q)/2=1/2 and arccos(1/2)=pi/3, hence 1-2/3=1/3. At q=2, arccos(1/sqrt(2))=pi/4, hence 1-1/2=1/2.
remaining_gap: Check whether local 2/3 used a different spin convention before modifying any live record; square-bond conformal invariance remains unresolved.
scope: source formula and arithmetic, not new percolation theorem

statement: For finite product cell laws mu=product_i mu_i and nu=product_i nu_i on a common state skeleton and Boolean f, |E_nu f-E_mu f| <= sum_i TV(mu_i,nu_i) P_Hi(S_i), with H_i the actual exterior hybrid law and S_i exterior nonconstancy in cell i.
assumptions: Finite cells; independent variables within each endpoint law; common deterministic event function; hybrid exterior in the stated replacement order.
source_quote: if S_i(x)=0 the difference of the conditional expectations is zero
proof_or_counterexample: Independently telescope endpoint product measures; condition each term on exterior x. Constant sections give zero; nonconstant sections are event sets B_x bounded by cell TV. Three-cell AND with mu_i=1/4 and nu_i=1/2 gives equality 0.109375=0.109375.
remaining_gap: C0017 needs a faithful common skeleton and sum of hybrid-weighted errors tending to zero; neither is proved.

statement: A finite graph with three distinct terminals and independent nondegenerate bond probabilities cannot have only all-disconnected and all-connected terminal partitions with both masses positive; for m fair bonds connecting all three in the deterministic graph, TV from such an all-or-none law is at least 2^(-m).
assumptions: Finite undirected graph; three distinct terminals; independent edge states with each p_e in (0,1); fair-edge bound additionally p_e=1/2.
source_quote: Declare exactly the edges of P open and every other edge of G closed.
proof_or_counterexample: Independently choose a spanning tree and minimal subtree spanning terminals. A leaf terminal c lies off the tree path P joining the other two. The exactly-P-open configuration has positive probability and yields partial partition ab|c; at fair p it has mass 2^(-m).
remaining_gap: Growing approximate gadgets and dependent constructions remain possible; does not settle C0017.

statement: An abstract edge field can satisfy F_E-F_W+i(F_N-F_S)=0 exactly with each orientation family uniformly 1-Lipschitz, while its four-edge average is Re z and is not holomorphic.
assumptions: Square grid; horizontal F(e)=conjugate(z_e); vertical F(e)=z_e; no additional percolation-specific identities.
proof_or_counterexample: F_E-F_W=delta and F_N-F_S=i delta, so residual is zero; average Re z; contour integral of Re z around unit square is i. python -X utf8 verify_weak_cr.py checked n=1,2,4,8 with zero residual and integral i.
remaining_gap: No claim about the actual FK q=1 observable; orientation coherence and boundary identification remain open.

statement: Endpoint-only sensitivity probabilities cannot replace hybrid probabilities in w417-L1, even for independent monotone Boolean events.
assumptions: Three independent Bernoulli bits; majority event; endpoint parameters epsilon and 1-epsilon with 0<epsilon<1/2.
source_quote: The three correct hybrid sensitivity probabilities are 2 epsilon(1-epsilon), (1-epsilon)^2+epsilon^2, 2 epsilon(1-epsilon).
proof_or_counterexample: At epsilon=0.01 endpoint substitution gives 0.058212 while actual event difference is 0.999404. The true hybrid sum times TV=0.999404. Independently expanded majority probabilities as 3p^2-2p^3.
remaining_gap: Need estimates under every actual hybrid law for a C0017 cell comparison.

statement: Smirnov Theorem 2.2 proves delta^(-1/2) F_delta -> (Phi')^(1/2) for q=2 critical FK-Ising in Caratheodory-convergent marked Dobrushin square-lattice domains, not the q=1 independent-bond Cardy/SLE6 target.
assumptions: q=2, p=sqrt(2)/(1+sqrt(2)), Dobrushin conditions, marked-domain Caratheodory convergence, mesh to zero.
source_quote: Then for the Ising model the corresponding functions F_j converge uniformly away from the boundary
proof_or_counterexample: Primary theorem hypotheses and conclusion read directly; q=1 is separately Conjecture 2.4 in that paper and is not instantiated by Theorem 2.2.
remaining_gap: No q=1 observable scaling theorem or target Cardy/SLE6 conclusion follows from this source theorem alone.
